Officer's narrative
Responding to a two-vehicle collision in League City, Texas, I found Driver 1 and Driver 2 stopped in the same lane
facing each other, with front-end damage to both vehicles. The damage on each vehicle is consistent with a
low-speed head-on impact and matches the impact described by Driver 2. Driver 2 stated the collision happened as I
have described it, and two independent witnesses gave accounts that agree with Driver 2 on the sequence of events.
Photographs taken at the scene show the damage and its position on both vehicles. Driver 1 reported neck and back
strain and was evaluated at the scene. The injury reported is consistent with the focre of this type of crash. Both
witnesses and I observed that Driver 1 was not inside the vehicle when the collision occurred. I found no indication of
earlier damage to either vehicle. Records show Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No
citations were issued at the scene. This narrative is based on the information available at the time of my investigation.
</page>
